steps.title: Prepare cell samples and controls
steps.instruction: Seed optional ACH‑2 positive control, thaw or thaw‑prepare PBMCs, pellet cells, and wash once with PBS.

substeps.instruction: Optional positive control: seed 5 × 10⁶ ACH‑2 cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL on Day 0 and stimulate with 10 ng/mL TNF‑α overnight.
Pre‑warm PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer to room temperature and aliquot the volume needed for the day.
Use fresh PBMCs directly; if frozen, thaw according to standard protocol. Harvest cultured cells if used. Aim for 2–5 × 10⁶ cells per sample.
Transfer cells in their medium to PrimeFlow RNA 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge ~400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 1 mL PBS, centrifuge ~400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Surface antibody staining (optional) and fixation
steps.instruction: Stain surface markers if desired, treat with microRNA pretreatment buffer, and fix cells with fixation buffer 1.

substeps.instruction: Optional: incubate cells with fluorescently‑labelled surface antibodies (and/or a fixable viability dye) in FACS buffer for 30 min on ice (4 °C) in the dark. Keep samples protected from light thereafter.
Wash with 1 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge (≈400 × g, 5 min), discard supernatant.
Prepare 1 mL PrimeFlow microRNA pretreatment buffer per sample by mixing 0.25 mL pretreatment concentrate (4×) with 0.75 mL pretreatment diluent. Keep at room temperature, protected from light.
Add 1 mL pretreatment buffer to each tube, mix gently, incubate 15 min at room temperature in the dark (buffer contains formaldehyde).
Centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant (increase speed after fixation).
Wash with 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Prepare 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA fixation buffer 1 per sample by mixing 0.5 mL fixation buffer 1A with 0.5 mL fixation buffer 1B (both contain formaldehyde).
Add 1 mL fixation buffer 1 to each tube, invert to mix, incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.
Centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Permeabilize and intracellular staining
steps.instruction: Permeabilize cells, optionally stain intracellular proteins, and perform a second fixation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2 mL PrimeFlow RNA permeabilization buffer with RNase inhibitors per sample: dilute 0.2 mL 10× permeabilization buffer with 1.8 mL RNase‑free water and add RNase inhibitor 1/100 (v/v). Keep on ice at 4 °C.
Add 1 mL permeabilization buffer to each tube, invert, centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Repeat the previous permeabilization step (add 1 mL buffer, mix, centrifuge, discard).
Optional: incubate cells with fluorescent intracellular antibodies in permeabilization buffer (with RNase inhibitors) for 30 min at 4 °C in the dark (titrate antibodies beforehand).
Wash with 1 mL permeabilization buffer (with RNase inhibitors), centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Prepare 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA fixation buffer 2 per sample by diluting 0.125 mL 8× fixation buffer 2 with 0.875 mL PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer. Keep at room temperature.
Add 1 mL fixation buffer 2 to each tube, invert, incubate 1 h at room temperature in the dark.
Centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer at room temperature; after the final wash, leave ~100 µL supernatant and resuspend cells in that residual volume.

steps.title: Hybridize target probes
steps.instruction: Thaw and dilute HIV‑1 probe sets, hybridize to cellular RNA, then wash and add RNase inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 20× target probe sets at room temperature and pre‑warm PrimeFlow RNA target probe diluent to 40 °C.
Prepare 100 µL of 1× diluted probe mix per sample: e.g., 5 µL probe + 95 µL diluent for a single probe; for two probes use 5 µL each + 90 µL diluent. (Diluent contains formamide).
Add 100 µL diluted probe mix directly to the cell suspension, mix gently, and incubate 2 h at 40 °C in the dark. Invert samples once after 1 h. Hold temperature at 40 ± 1 °C.
Wash twice with 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer at room temperature.
Add RNase inhibitor to wash buffer at 1/100 dilution.
Add 1 mL wash buffer (with RNase inhibitor) to each tube, invert, centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate all but ~100 µL and resuspend cells in the residual volume.
Pause point: store samples overnight in the dark at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare compensation controls
steps.instruction: Generate single‑color bead controls for each fluorochrome used in probes and antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Label a tube for each fluorochrome to be compensated.
Pulse‑vortex UltraComp eBeads microspheres, add 1 drop to each tube.

Add 5 µL of the appropriate PrimeFlow Compensation control (for each probe fluorochrome) or equivalent antibody control to the corresponding tube. Mix briefly, vortex, and incubate 15–30 min in the dark at 4 °C.
Wash with 1 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate all but 100 µL supernatant.
Add 100 µL intracellular fixation (IC) buffer to each tube, vortex briefly (IC buffer contains formamide).
Pause point: store bead controls in the dark at 4 °C for up to 5 days.

steps.title: Amplify probe signal
steps.instruction: Perform Pre‑Amp and Amp steps, then label probes, washing between each step.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑warm samples, PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer, and PrimeFlow RNA PreAmp mix to 40 °C.
Add 100 µL PreAmp mix to each cell suspension, pipette gently, incubate 1.5 h at 40 °C (mix contains formamide).
Pre‑warm RNA Amp mix to 40 °C.
Add 1 mL wash buffer to each tube, invert, centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate all but ~100 µL. Repeat this wash step twice more (total three washes).
Add 100 µL Amp mix to each tube, mix, incubate 2 h at 40 °C.
Wash with 1 mL wash buffer, centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate to ~100 µL. Repeat this wash step twice more (total three washes).
Thaw 100× RNA label probes on ice in the dark. Pre‑warm label probe diluent to 40 °C.
Dilute 1 µL label probe (100×) in 99 µL label probe diluent for each sample.
Add 100 µL diluted label probe to each tube, mix gently, incubate 1 h at 40 °C.
Add 1 mL PrimeFlow RNA storage buffer (or FACS buffer) to each tube, invert, centrifuge 800 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate to ~100 µL. Repeat this wash step once more.
Transfer samples to FACS tubes and resuspend in an appropriate volume of storage buffer or FACS buffer for acquisition.
Optional pause point: store samples overnight in the dark at 4 °C before acquisition.

steps.title: Acquire samples on flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Set up compensation, adjust voltages, apply gating, and collect sufficient events per sample.

substeps.instruction: Run compensation controls: wash each bead control with FACS buffer, centrifuge 600 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate to ~100 µL, resuspend in appropriate volume of FACS buffer.
Acquire single‑color bead samples and an unstained sample to generate the compensation matrix; adjust voltages so positive and negative populations are well separated.
Assign each bead tube to its fluorochrome in the compensation software, gate on bead population, and calculate the matrix to correct spectral spillover.
Apply the compensation matrix to all experimental samples during acquisition or in downstream analysis.
Define gating strategy using FSC, SSC, FSC‑H, FSC‑W, antibody fluorophores, and probe fluorophores (include a dump channel if desired). Verify probe staining success with the positive control.
Acquire each sample, collecting at least 5 × 10⁵ – 1 × 10⁶ events for PBMC samples to ensure reliable detection of probe signal.
